<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/route"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Ask a Proposal Mode router which model should serve a request. Put the request in `body` exactly as you'd send it to the provider (OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses or Anthropic Messages). The router scores it and returns its candidates, most recommended first; nothing is sent to any provider.

Your app then calls the first candidate's `model_id` with its own provider key (at the candidate's `effort`, when it has one), moves down the list if that call fails, and reports what the provider answered to `POST /v1/route/{decision_id}/usage`.

Routing is cache-aware within a session: send `session_id`, or the end client's headers in `headers` (where Claude Code, Codex and other known clients carry theirs), so a conversation's later turns can stay on the model whose prompt cache is warm.
